text:
katie: FYI vendor Sage Consulting submitted the April retainer but there's no PO on the PDF and our AP system didn't auto-route it. Invoice attached: https://files.redwood.example/sage-apr-inv.pdf

samir: can you drop the invoice number and vendor id? i'll look up routing.

katie: Inv# SC-2026-041, Vendor ID 78912. Total: $28,500. Lines look like: staffing retainer $25,000, travel $3,500. PO column = blank.

omar: AP bot flagged a legal entity mismatch yesterday for this vendor (prod vs operations). that can break routing.

ap-bot: automated message: invoice SC-2026-041 failed PO match -> status: HOLD. reason: missing PO and entity mismatch. Ticket ID: AP-6483.

samir: thanks. looks like this should have been billed against the "Platform Eng" contract (PO 46211). vendor used the legacy master agreement. we need either (a) vendor issues corrected invoice with PO 46211, or (b) accounting creates a manual PO/GRN to clear.

katie: vendor is out of office until Monday. we can't wait on them for 5 business days — this is a recurring retainer and customer roadshow payments depend on it. any temporary workaround?

omar: two options — short term: create a one-off internal PO referencing 46211 and route to approver queue for Samir. Long term: update vendor mapping to prefer ops-entity.

samir: i'm fine approving a manual PO to unblock. can someone create the internal PO and tag it "manual-unmatched"? include GL code: 6002-ENG-TRAVEL and cost center ENG-REV.

katie: creating PO now. FYI snippet i'm entering into procurement portal:
```
vendor_id: 78912
invoice: SC-2026-041
amount: 28500
po_type: manual-unmatched
po_ref: MAN-1716504321
gl: 6002-ENG-TRAVEL
cost_center: ENG-REV
```

katie: created PO MAN-1716504321 and attached invoice. routing defaulted to samir -> jordan for approval. :white_check_mark:

jordan: i saw the routing. quick Q — travel was originally flagged as non-reimbursable under the master SOW, do we need to deduct $3.5k?

samir: good catch. check SOW clause 4.2: travel is billable for client-facing events. this is for the roadshow so keep full amount.

jordan: OK approving now. Approving MAN-1716504321. :thumbsup:

ap-bot: automated message: PO MAN-1716504321 approved by jordan at 1716504800. Invoice SC-2026-041 moved to MATCHED status. Ticket AP-6483 closed.

katie: awesome, thanks all. i'll email vendor to confirm we processed and that they can invoice with PO 46211 going forward.

omar: follow-up action: Ops to update vendor entity mapping for vendor_id 78912 to prefer ops-entity (so next month's retainer picks up PO automatically). assigned to omar.

omar: putting a calendar reminder to check next month's invoice routing.

samir: thanks team. saved some time and customer impact avoided. :rocket:
